title.narrative: WACOMP The Gambia: Increasing competitiveness through enhanced quality and compliance in the onion V

description.narrative: The overall objective (impact) of the project is to strengthen the competitiveness of The Gambia and enhance its integration into the sub-regional and international trading system.The specific objective (outcome) of the project is to improve the performance, growth and contribution to industry, regional trade and exports of onion and other horticulture VC.The project to be implemented by UNIDO will focus on interventions for the development and enhanced competitiveness of the onion VC. This VC sill be complemented with other horticulture VC, as necessary to get a critical mass for project support to the private sector, and to enhance capacity of institutions providing services to the horticultural VCs. These VCs have strong impact on household incomes and strong potential for import substitutions and for exports, so thus for job creation and growth through sub-regional value chain linkages. The targeted VCs are consistent with the priorities stated in the NDP 2018 - 2021 and it will also contribute to the ECOWAS regional industrialization priorities for agro-industries.
